discussion.title: Geometry-only design and scale-preserving matching agreed
discussion.status: Agreed — Design v2; working-product acceptance outstanding
discussion.summary: The human replied verbatim “agreed” to the presented v2 design and preserved-scale matching policy. The contract covers shell/local-browser page correction and book alignment, saved review, image-only export and public/full/native/pair/group test seams. Reordering and OCR are external. Scale normalization is not commissioned. No placement may silently clip content or certify unmeasured local distortion. Read the actual agreement/scope using the link above. The earned design review precedes implementation planning; no real output or historical comparison is accepted by this signature.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Settled preserved page scale for translation/padding and mirrored binding-margin placement.

diagrams.title: Geometry PDF and external passes
diagrams.caption: Design v2 preserves input order and every occurrence, expanding only confirmed genuine spreads. The useful output is accepted page images. Within-page evidence/correction is still required for full-default acceptance.

diagrams.title: Page sides and mirrored alignment
diagrams.caption: Left/right mapping is explicitly declared, not inferred from PDF index. Reference frames guide registration without cropping other content. Match top and inner placement by translation/padding at the agreed preserved scale; images themselves are never mirrored.

diagrams.title: Page correction and book placement
diagrams.caption: Original/current full and native views support local geometry; pair/group views expose placement, margins and sides. Any page is adjustable. Acceptance, discard/revert and unresolved reasons remain explicit.

diagrams.title: Geometry dependencies stay consistent
diagrams.caption: Saved projects resume without collection access. Local image changes, shared target/reference changes and side/split changes invalidate their dependent alignment proposals. Export freezes one accepted geometry snapshot with unchanged default ordering.
